text:
alex (oncall): taking over primary for the 09:00-21:00 UTC shift — quick handoff notes below. pls @mention if you want to pair during a page

incident-bot: Page triggered: high 5xx error rate on /v2/generate (eu-west). Pager: P0.

alex (oncall): saw the alert while wrapping up. current impact: increased 500s for a subset of EU customers (approx 3% of requests), latency spike ~600ms to 1.2s on the inference gateway. downgrading throughput to preserve stability. not yet paged product.

maria: noted. are we already failing over to dedicated pool?

alex (oncall): not automatically. manual fallback is in runbook for region outages. holding for 10m to see if error rate drops with throttling rules.

kevin: can you paste the short runbook clip for failover? new folks ask for the minimal steps.

alex (oncall): copying minimal steps from runbook:

```
1) check /incidents/dashboard for host error patterns
2) confirm 5xx originates from inference-gateway (search service=rt-infer)
3) set rate limit: POST /v2/generate -> 20rps for eu-west via config API
4) if errors persist >5min -> promote dedicated-pool-eu as fallback
   - run `rctl pool promote dedicated-pool-eu --traffic 100% --safe-rollout`
5) notify product & ops, mark incident P0 in ops board
```

alex (oncall): important: step 3 is reversible and least disruptive. try that before pool promote.

jess: FYI I'm the new on-call shadow this week — thanks for the handoff. planning to watch any pages and take notes. if I should practice the promote command in staging, tell me when.

alex (oncall): awesome, jess. please pair with me for the promote flow if it happens. also run through the checklist in staging later today 16:00 UTC.

samir: quick note about coverage: there is a gap this Friday 02:00-05:00 UTC where secondary rotation wasn't claimed. we should patch that before EOW.

maria: I saw that gap. I can swap my Saturday slot if someone takes the weekday evening.

kevin: I can take the Fri 02:00-05:00 UTC slot if that helps. prefer to avoid swapping my Sat if possible.

alex (oncall): thanks kevin, that would close the gap. jess, shadow pairing for that window? we could schedule a shorter handover at 01:30 UTC Friday.

jess: yes please, add me. I'd like to watch a real page if one happens, otherwise we can do a tabletop walkthrough.

incident-bot: Note: runbook link updated 2026-05-11 by "eng-runtime". https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-failover (read-only inside VPC)

maria: also flag: customer impact assessment flow is in the same runbook; when a P0 affects customers actively, we should create a short summary with: service, regions, %requests impacted, mitigation, ETA for full recovery. ops-team watches for that summary.

alex (oncall): correct. here's a minimal template to paste into incident ticket:

```
Service: inference-gateway (/v2/generate)
Region: eu-west
Impact: ~3% of requests returning 5xx; latency elevated
Mitigation: rate-limited POST /v2/generate to 20rps; investigating dependent backend (rt-infer)
Next action: if errors persist >5min -> promote dedicated-pool-eu
ETA: TBD
Notes: collecting logs and traces (trace IDs: 0xabc123, 0xdef456)
```

kevin: what about customer-facing comms? who drafts the initial note?

alex (oncall): ops oncall typically drafts short status and pings product. if product wants to escalate to account teams we'll coordinate. jess, part of your shadowing is practicing the customer-impact blurb.

jess: noted. I'll prepare a draft in the incident ticket if we need it.

samir: small ops tip — when promoting the pool, add `--no-auto-scale` flag to keep capacity predictable during rollout. saved us last month.

alex (oncall): good call. I'm updating the internal checklist.

maria: can we also add a quick checklist item for verifying KV cache warmup after promote? customers notice cold-start regressions.

alex (oncall): yes — add `post-promote: run cache-warmup job for top-10 prefixes` to runbook. adding that after this thread.

incident-bot: Incident P0 created: INC-2026-0423-7 by alex (oncall) — assigned: eng-oncall.

alex (oncall): ok result from throttling: error rate dropped to baseline in ~6m after rate-limits and a restart of the inference proxy on 3 nodes. marking interim mitigation. I'll stay primary for 30m then hand back to maria unless anything else pops.

maria: thanks — I'll be ready to take primary at 12:00 UTC. jess, ping me if you want a quick retrospective after shift.

jess: will do. thanks for the pairing offer, alex. learned a lot watching the steps.

kevin: nice fast mitigation. can we add the specific quick-restart command to the runbook? `sudo systemctl restart infer-proxy` — or is there a safer rolling command?

samir: use the orchestrated rolling restart: `rctl host restart --service infer-proxy --rolling 3` — less blast radius.

alex (oncall): adding that variant. also adding a short note: "preferred mitigation order: throttle -> rolling restart -> promote pool".

maria: perfect. one last thing — jess, after shadow week ends we'll add you as a secondary on the weekend rota for one shift. ops will confirm once you complete the staging run.

jess: excited, thanks all.

alex (oncall): closing the handoff thread. if anyone wants the raw logs i pulled, DM me and i'll drop a sanitized gist. good job team :thumbsup:
